name: dsh-lark-bot
description: dsh-lark-bot：把 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 桥接进飞书/Lark 的 bot：流式卡片、项目工作区、并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理与安全网守护（dsh 崩溃后飞书仍可自救）。A bridge bot connecting DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into Feishu/Lark: streaming cards, workspaces, parallel tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian.
